title: Speculative enquiry: graduate civil/structural internship or junior design support
content_text: DesignDevise careers page (Melbourne CBD): invites structural engineers, architects and draftspersons to collaborate. Quote: If you are a recent civil/structural engineering graduate and have strong interest in design, we encourage you to apply for an internship role at DesignDevise. Please fill in the form to register your interest. Contact published on same page: contact@designdevise.com.au, LEVEL 1, 530 LITTLE COLLINS STREET, MELBOURNE VIC 3000, 0481 222 990. Chartered Civil and Structural Engineers with Engineers Australia.
apply_instructions: Email contact@designdevise.com.au (published on careers page) with resume and cover letter registering interest in graduate/internship design support, or use the careers form.
